summary: Frontend-only regression of the 'txns.map is not a function' fix. Logged in as admin on the public preview URL and verified /approvals, /bank, /transactions and / (dashboard). No red error overlay, no pageerror, no console JS errors on any page. Approvals renders 3 pending rows with Approve/Reject/Query buttons; Bank Recon renders both panels; Transactions shows the totals footer '7 transactions ... Income +Rs9,85,000 Total Rs56,500' and the detail modal with all 5 tabs (Details/Approval/Payment/Proof/History); Dashboard renders Action Required (7 items) + 13 KPI tiles and the 'Pending approvals' tile navigates to /approvals. Also exercised the approve action end-to-end: approving staff-created TXN-000007 succeeded, row disappeared and persisted after reload (3 -> 2 rows).

minor.issue: Returns 403 'Requester cannot approve their own transaction' (correct maker-checker rule), but seeded pending items TXN-000005 and TXN-000006 were created by the admin account itself, so they are permanently unapprovable and the dashboard 'Pending approvals' count stays stuck at 2. Consider hiding/greying the Approve button for own-created rows or reseeding those under the staff account.

action_items: Optional UX: on /approvals, disable or hide Approve/Reject for rows where t.created_by === current user email, since the API rejects those with 403 (currently the user only learns after clicking).
critical_code_review_comments: Approvals.jsx/BankRecon.jsx now correctly read response.data.items with || [] fallback - verified live. Other consumers of GET /api/transactions were grepped indirectly via page testing (Transactions.jsx, Dashboard, Money In/Out, Personal Payments all loaded without errors).
Approvals.jsx load() has no try/catch or loading state - a failing /transactions or /tenders call leaves an empty table with no error feedback.
seed_data_creation: None created. Mutated existing data: TXN-000007 (Courier Rs250, staff-created) was approved during the approve happy-path test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reported bug is fixed and verified on the public URL. Remaining pending approvals (TXN-000005, TXN-000006) are admin-created and cannot be approved by admin due to maker-checker 403; use the staff login to create a txn if you need a fresh approvable item. No Playwright/pytest files were added this iteration - all testing done via browser_automation_tool.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/transactions changed from array to {items,count,total_expense,total_income}; Approvals.jsx setTxns(response.data) stored an object, so txns.map threw. Fix (response.data.items || []) confirmed effective; BankRecon.jsx same-pattern fix also confirmed.
